about:
# ItemRack Universal

ItemRack is an equipment-set, quick-swap, event, and cooldown-queue addon for World of Warcraft Classic clients.

One release archive supports:

- Classic Era, Hardcore, and Season of Discovery
- Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary
- WoW Forever/Camelot

There are no separate Forever and TBC editions. Every client uses the same `ItemRack-universal-{Version}.zip` and the same source tree.

## Supported clients

| Client family | Interface metadata | Common installation folder |
|---|---|---|
| Classic Era, Hardcore, Season of Discovery | `11508`, `11509` | `_classic_era_` |
| Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary | `20505`, `20506` | `_anniversary_` or `_classic_` |
| WoW Forever/Camelot | `11601`, `16001`, `AllowLoadGameType: camelot` | `_classic_beta_` |

ItemRack detects the APIs exposed by the running client. Legacy globals, modern `C_*` namespaces, missing UI helpers, and protected/secret-value differences are handled inside one shared compatibility layer.

## Installation

1. Download the newest ZIP from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Bl4ut0/ItemRack-Universal/releases) or [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/itemrack-universal).
2. Extract it into the selected client's `Interface\AddOns` directory.
3. Confirm these two folders exist directly under `AddOns`:
   - `ItemRack`
   - `ItemRackOptions`
4. Restart the client or run `/reload`.

`ItemRackOptions` is ItemRack's load-on-demand configuration module. It is included in the same distribution and is not a separate addon download.

The addon list displays **ItemRack Universal** and **ItemRack Universal Options**. Keep the folder names `ItemRack` and `ItemRackOptions`: these stable module identifiers are used by dependencies and asset paths. The product name and ZIP name do not require renaming those folders.

## Main features

- Save and equip full or partial gear sets.
- Bind sets and individual equipment slots to keys.
- Weapon-only saved-set hotkeys equip during combat. Enable **Full-set hotkeys swap weapons in combat** in Global Settings to also equip the weapon portion of full sets immediately and finish the remaining gear after combat. This requires a key assigned with **Sets > Bind Key**; flyout clicks, `/itemrack equip` macros, events, and queues remain deferred. Combat presses equip rather than toggle; empty-slot and rune-specific weapon requests remain deferred.
- Add movable quick-access buttons from the character sheet.
- Open flyout menus containing compatible carried and banked items.
- Automatically equip sets for specializations, stances, mounting, movement, zones, buffs, drinking, and other events.
- Configure per-slot and per-set cooldown queues.
- Distinguish same-base items with different enchants, gems, suffixes, or runes.
- Defer restricted swaps safely through combat, casting, loading screens, and item locks.
- Use one-frame multi-item pipelining where the client permits it.

See the [controls reference](https://github.com/Bl4ut0/ItemRack-Universal/blob/master/docs/CONTROLS.md) for the full mouse, keybinding, macro, and slash-command reference. The packaged [ItemRack guide](https://github.com/Bl4ut0/ItemRack-Universal/blob/master/ItemRack/readme.txt) includes a detailed explanation, scope, dependency, and fresh-profile default for every setting.

## Quick start

- `/itemrack opt` opens ItemRack Options.
- Right-click the minimap button to open Options.
- Left-click the minimap button to select a saved set.
- Alt-click an equipment slot on the character sheet to create or remove its quick-access button.
- Alt-click the character model to create or remove the set button.
- Use the **Sets** tab to save gear and assign specialization links.
- Use the **Events** tab to explicitly enable automatic triggers.
- Use the **Queue** tab to prioritize cooldown items.

Linking a set to a specialization does not silently approve every automatic behavior. Review and enable the corresponding event when you want ItemRack to control that transition.

## Script-event safety

Script events execute Lua with addon privileges. ItemRack therefore requires an explicit trust decision:

- A valid script saved through ItemRack's editor is approved for its exact name, trigger, and source.
- A script inserted or changed externally remains disabled until the player accepts ItemRack's warning prompt.
- Changing approved source invalidates the approval.
- Rejected or invalid external additions cannot persist through ItemRack's saved script-event path.

WoW addons share one Lua environment, so no addon can fully sandbox another hostile addon or WeakAura. Remove any untrusted addon or aura that introduced malicious code.

## Diagnostics and bug reports

1. Run `/itemrack debug`.
2. Reproduce the problem.
3. Run `/itemrack dump`.
4. Copy the generated report and review it before sharing.

The dump includes the ItemRack release version/build ID, client state, event ownership, equipment transactions, queues, locks, and recent diagnostic entries. It may contain set names and item information, but not account passwords.

Please include:

- Client family and client build
- ItemRack version
- Exact reproduction steps
- Expected and actual set names
- Relevant item links, enchants, gems, or runes
- Full Lua error text
- `/itemrack dump` output

Report issues at [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Bl4ut0/ItemRack-Universal/issues) or on the [CurseForge comments page](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/itemrack-universal/comments).

## Development

Run the complete gate from the repository root:

```powershell
npm.cmd ci
npm.cmd test
```

Every reproducible user-reported bug must receive a named permanent regression in the standard `npm test` gate. See the [testing workflow](https://github.com/Bl4ut0/ItemRack-Universal/blob/master/docs/TESTING.md) and [beta test checklist](https://github.com/Bl4ut0/ItemRack-Universal/blob/master/docs/BETA_TEST_CHECKLIST.md). The [documentation index](https://github.com/Bl4ut0/ItemRack-Universal/blob/master/docs/README.md) links the remaining user and engineering references.

Release builds are exported from immutable Git commits. The only supported artifact is `ItemRack-universal-{Version}.zip`; client-specific source branches and packages are retired. See the [release workflow](https://github.com/Bl4ut0/ItemRack-Universal/blob/master/.agents/workflows/release.md).

## Credits

- Original ItemRack author: **Gello**
- Classic maintainers: **Rottenbeer** and **Roadblock**
- Anniversary and universal maintenance: **Bl4ut0**

This project builds on [ItemRack Classic](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/itemrack-classic) and preserves the original addon's license.

# ItemRack Universal v4.59

This stable release consolidates the tested beta changes for this version.

## Changes

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- **Physical Hybrid candidate recognition (#38, beta18 follow-up)**: Inferring another saved set now checks its explicit worn items, rather than accepting membership in that other set's AutoQueue. Active-set queue-aware matching and queue authority remain unchanged. Added a reporter-derived permanent regression for the shirt mismatch and unrelated Drakes cloak queue; live acceptance remains pending.
- **Targeted swap audio**: With item-aware LibSoundIndex, each submitted equipment move briefly mutes the candidate sound files for the items it touches. Audio remains at its normal settings when the library is missing or has no matching item data.
- **Custom state icon and Per-Set-only Hybrid splits**: Hybrid split indicators on Button 20 and the minimap button now activate only when both AutoQueue (`EnableQueues`) and `Use per-set queues` (`EnablePerSetQueues`) are enabled. With global queues only, matching another saved set adopts it cleanly without splitting, and unmatched gear restores the classic solid `ItemRackIcon` (`"Custom"`). With per-set queues enabled, unmatched gear retaining an active queue displays a Custom Hybrid Split (`Active Queue Set | Custom` icon on left/right with `"Custom"` Button 20 text and matching active-queue/re-equip tooltips).
- **Specialization event stack unroll after manual set selection**: Pruned overridden 0-slot `Specialization` frames on full manual set equip (and excluded empty non-owning frames when computing `Pop` restoration targets) so temporary overlays such as `Mounted` -> stop unroll cleanly back to the manually selected set instead of reverting to an unchanged spec's set, while actual spec changes still activate bound specialization sets.
- **AutoQueue reconciliation after temporary event overlays**: Exiting a temporary event overlay (`~EventFrame`) now evaluates higher-priority ready AutoQueue candidates directly for restored slots (`TryReconcileEventFrames` / `ResolveRestoredQueueSlotTarget`) and triggers `PeriodicQueueCheck` once `CurrentSet` settles (including post-swap queue checks after non-event swaps in `EndSetSwap`).
- **Shift+Click chat-link editbox focus guard**: `ButtonPostClick` and `MenuOnClick` now use `ItemRack.GetActiveChatEditBox()` (`ChatFrameUtil.GetActiveWindow` / `ChatEdit_GetActiveWindow`, focused `GetCurrentKeyBoardFocus` including custom chat addons such as Chattynator, or focused `ChatFrame1EditBox`) instead of bare `ChatFrame1EditBox:IsVisible()`. Resting visible General chat editboxes no longer intercept `Shift+Click` toggles or insert unwanted item links into chat.
- **Per-set AutoQueue editing during active event sets**: Deferred `EndSetSwap` Options UI synchronization on `~EventFrame` swaps until `EventFramePlanFinished` / `QueueEventFrameTargets` updates `ItemRackUser.CurrentSet` (`SyncOptionsEditingSet`), and updated `ItemRackOpt.SetupQueue(id, targetSetName)` so quick-access `Alt+Left-Click`, `Alt+Right-Click`, `ButtonMenu` Auto Queue, and `SetQueue` target `ItemRackUser.CurrentSet` instead of a stale `ItemRackOptSetsName` from another set. Editing or toggling AutoQueue on an event set such as a movement set now updates and persists on that active event set across event exit.
- **Swimming event detection, exit restoration, and Set Picker UX**: Fixed `PushEvent` `restoreOnExit` for `Script` events (so `UnequipEventSet()` and `PopEvent()` restore pre-event gear cleanly) and preserved `state.baseSetName` across coalesced single-transition `EventFrames.Activate` replacements without duplicating `Pop`. Added `ItemRack.ProcessSwimmingEvent` checking `IsSwimming() or IsSubmerged()` across `MIRROR_TIMER_START`, `RegisterEvents`, `RunAllEvents`, and the 0.5s `CheckForMountedEvents` poll loop while leaving `DefaultEvents.Swimming.Script`, `StackedSwimmingScript`, and existing users' `local set = "..."` scripts untouched and respecting `IsScriptEventApproved` / manual overrides. Canonical approved `Swimming` events now support Set Picker (`SubFrame5`) assignment and set icon preview via `ItemRack.ResolveSwimmingSetName` and `ItemRack.CanUseSetPickerForEvent` alongside the existing Lua editor (`Edit` / double-click), while custom modified `Script` events continue running via `ProcessScriptTriggers`.
- **Shift+Click anchored quick-access breakouts (#39)**: Added the `Shift+Click keeps breakout open` (`KeepMenuOpen`) option under Breakouts & Flyout Menus. `Shift+Left-Click` on any quick-access item button (`0..19`, outside an open chat editbox, in or out of combat) locks or unlocks its breakout open in an anchored frame underneath normal hover breakouts (`ItemRackMenuFrame`). Item clicks inside the locked breakout equip/queue/hold (supporting both `TrinketMenu` mode `Left=Top`/`Right=Bottom` and standard `Left=swap`/`Right=hold`) without closing the breakout, while hovering other quick-access or character-sheet slots still opens and closes normal hover breakouts on top. Character-sheet menus and Set button `Shift+Click` unequip stay untouched, and locked slots persist per character across reloads.
- **Quick-Access breakout render diagnostics**: Added `/itemrack debug breakouts` and the `Breakouts` debug tag to inspect what may prevent quick-access breakouts from opening or rendering (`ButtonsDocking`, `MenuOnShift`, `MenuOnRight`, hidden/zero-alpha/offscreen buttons or frames, mouse focus/obscuring overlays, snapshot counts, and hover/pinned geometry), with bounded `gateEvents` and live probe summaries included automatically under `BREAKOUT DISCOVERY DIAGNOSTICS` in `/itemrack dump`.
- **WoW Forever dual-specialization event/API alignment**: Added `_G.GetNumSpecGroups` fallback for `GetNumTalentGroups`, registered `ItemRack.IsForever()` and `ACTIVE_COMBAT_CONFIG_CHANGED` for spec updates, and dispatched `PLAYER_TALENT_UPDATE` and `ACTIVE_COMBAT_CONFIG_CHANGED` through `SpecChangeTimer` when `GetActiveTalentGroup()` changes (live level-40+ Forever verification remains pending).
- **Combat breakout discovery and snapshot preservation (WoW Forever 1.60.1)**: Fixed empty combat breakout menus when `OnEnteringCombat` / live combat discovery scans bag items that display temporary red combat-lock notices (such as `"Cannot change equip status while in combat"` on Forever 1.60.1.70959, including short <= 4-line item tooltips and localized `ERR_NOT_IN_COMBAT` / `SPELL_FAILED_AFFECTING_COMBAT` globals). Temporary combat-lock tooltip lines no longer fail wearability filtering, while genuine level, class, race, and proficiency restrictions remain enforced. Hardened `StoreMenuSnapshot` so combat/transition scans cannot overwrite an existing populated out-of-combat snapshot with an empty one, restored `ItemRack.Menu` safely on scan errors in `RefreshQuickAccessMenuSnapshots`, and refreshed out-of-combat snapshots on `BANKFRAME_CLOSED`.
- **Chained AutoQueue settlement and Hybrid settling guard (#38)**: Immediately drain pending out-of-combat `CombatQueue` swaps when an `EquipItemByID` / set transaction completes instead of waiting for the next periodic timer tick, and treat pending out-of-combat `CombatQueue` work as `inventory_settling` in `UpdateCurrentSet()` (while leaving in-combat and dead-player detection active). Also cleared manual/burnt slot holds across `QueueSync` mirrored slots during `EquipSet`. Eliminates brief false Hybrid matches (such as a 1-slot banked-cloak set) between multi-slot AutoQueue transactions after set swaps.
- **External swap quick-access button icon synchronization (#39)**: Registered `PLAYER_EQUIPMENT_CHANGED` cleanly via `pcall` and triggered inventory reconciliation/refresh in `LocksChanged()` when an inventory button lock clears or equipped state settles externally (while skipping spurious refreshes on bag-only locks). Ensures quick-access button icons and `ManualQueueChoice` stay synchronized after external addon swaps suc
